sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 21 August 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000040-P1 was put before Blue Ridge Medical Group 040 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 870 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
